description: This file implements modulation mapping functions for various modulation schemes, including lookup tables for QAM and BPSK, and functions to modulate bits into complex symbols with scaling factors.

classes.name: modulator_table_s
classes.description: Template class for generating lookup tables for QAM modulation schemes, supporting modulation of bits into complex symbols with scaling.

classes.name: modulator_table_bpsk
classes.description: Class for BPSK modulation lookup table, providing methods to modulate bits into complex symbols.

classes.name: modulator_table_pi_2_bpsk
classes.description: Class for π/2-BPSK modulation lookup table, providing methods to modulate bits into complex symbols with phase shifts.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Function to modulate input bits into complex symbols based on the specified modulation scheme.

methods.name: get_modulation_scaling
methods.description: Returns the scaling factor associated with a given modulation scheme.
